command_line:
set -eu
{
  printenv | sort | sed -n '1,80p'
  echo '--- /software ---'
  find /software -maxdepth 3 -type f -o -type l | sort | sed -n '1,240p'
  echo '--- bins ---'
  find /usr/local/bin /usr/bin /opt/conda/bin /software -maxdepth 3 -type f -perm -111 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,240p'
  echo '--- python caper croo qc2tsv modules ---'
  python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util
for m in ['caper','croo','qc2tsv','cromwell_tools']:
    spec=importlib.util.find_spec(m)
    print(m, spec.origin if spec else 'MISSING')
PY
} > probe_details.txt
